records.gloss_en: a device that reads images or text and converts them into digital data
records.scope: electronic scanning device; does not assert a person who scans
records.rationale: Both Chinese labels describe the scanning device, so define equipment rather than scanning action.

records.gloss_en: in the middle of or surrounded by something
records.scope: spatial or figurative within; do not conflate chronological during unless contextual evidence
records.rationale: Amid locates a thing within surrounding circumstances or an environment; Chinese temporal extension should not be silently added to KU.

records.gloss_en: to travel regularly between home and work or a place of study
records.scope: commuting verb sense; noun commute and generic return travel must not be silently combined
records.rationale: Original Chinese includes broad 往返, but commute is normally a regular home-to-work/school journey; check KU POS and grammar before changing global sense.

records.gloss_en: to run slowly and steadily, especially for exercise
records.scope: jog as in jogging; small push or nudge is a separate sense
records.rationale: 慢跑 and 轻推 are different verbal meanings, so original KU cannot retain both under a single specific English definition.

records.gloss_en: a metric unit of volume equal to 1,000 milliliters
records.scope: unit of volume; American spelling liter
records.rationale: Quantity and unit are unambiguous; gloss avoids placeholder and gives precise physical dimension.

records.gloss_en: to make someone feel extremely surprised or shocked
records.scope: emotional shock; temporary loss of consciousness/ability is another sense
records.rationale: Original Chinese combines psychological surprise with physical incapacitation; do not equate them in one KU.

records.gloss_en: a building or place that is easily recognized and helps people identify a location
records.scope: geographical landmark; milestone/important event is a figurative separate sense
records.rationale: Landmark as physical reference point and landmark as major historical development should not share one narrow gloss.

records.gloss_en: to remove the outer covering or skin from something
records.scope: verb peel; the skin of fruit is a noun sense requiring POS validation
records.rationale: Original Chinese combines verb action and noun object, so a gloss-only replacement must await KU POS/sense decision.

records.gloss_en: words printed near an image to explain what it shows
records.scope: image caption; on-screen subtitles/closed captions require context
records.rationale: Photo captions and subtitles can be related but are different media contexts; avoid asserting a single KU encompasses both.

records.gloss_en: a building or room equipped for exercise, physical training, or indoor sports
records.rationale: A facility definition covers both Chinese uses without asserting a specific form of sports hall.

records.gloss_en: a word used to name a person, place, thing, idea, or quality
records.rationale: Precise grammatical definition with no competing POS.

records.gloss_en: the ability of two things to work well together or exist together without conflict
records.rationale: Defines relational property behind both Chinese synonyms; avoids restricting to software.

records.gloss_en: an amount of money returned to someone who has paid for something
records.scope: noun refund; verb to refund requires KU POS validation
records.rationale: Original Chinese may indicate noun and verb; verify original KU POS before deciding whether both belong.

records.gloss_en: the process of bringing separate groups or parts together to form one whole
records.rationale: The process meaning covers merger and integration without presuming technical fusion.

records.gloss_en: money paid for instruction at a school, college, or university
records.scope: fees meaning, especially US English; teaching/instruction differs
records.rationale: Original Chinese joins payment and instructional activity, distinct senses with geographic variation.

policy.scope: First 15 by rank from the mechanical placeholder census; lexicographic proposals, not confirmed full sense rebindings.
policy.qa_next: Muse independent review of exact records, target KU POS+usage references then additive changes where necessary; only non-disputed glosses roll into stable-ID overlay.
